title: Capacity to ship packages within D days
statement: Packages with weights must ship in the given order; each day the ship carries a contiguous run whose total weight is at most its capacity. Return the least capacity that ships everything within days days.
hints: The capacity is between max(weights) and sum(weights).
Given a capacity, greedily load each day as full as possible and count days.

solution.explanation: Feasibility is monotone in capacity, and checking a capacity is a greedy pass (fill each day until the next package doesn't fit). Binary-search the smallest feasible capacity between max and sum.
